cs.t: I brought my mouse (logitech m500) because all other mice are just no comparison. Then I asked my boss and he got one for me to use in the workplace. I've also brought my own keyboard sometimes, because the keyboards they have there are all just... so bad. It's a big clunky thing however so I've only done it 2-3 times. I've recently ordered my first mechanical keyboard, tenkeyless, so that should be more portable. I'll stay on top of whether I'm making too much noise, though.
